Heathcliff was heavily wounded. It looked as though he could hardly stand, let alone wield a weapon.
希斯克利夫满身伤痕，似乎连拿稳武器的力气都没有了。

Wuthering Heights Laboratory
呼啸山庄 实验室

dataList.content:
Fuck... fuck!
妈的……妈的！

The club clattered to the floor and rolled away as the last vestiges of strength left him.
随着最后一丝力气也消失殆尽，他手里的球棒掉在了地上。

When I left this manor by my own volition, I...
当我自愿离开这座宅邸的时候……

... I promised to myself that I would return a changed man.
我对自己发誓要做出改变再回来。

So that I could at least stand proud before Catherine. So that she won't be embarrassed of me.
我想这样至少当我站在凯瑟琳面前时，她就不会再为我感到难堪……

But... look at me. I couldn't protect her in the end. I can't even get nearer to her or hold my weapons proper, like an idiot.
但……你看看我。到头来我还是保护不了凯瑟琳，连接近她都难如登天。我像个傻子一样，甚至连武器都握不稳。

<Heathcliff...>
<希斯克利夫……>

I know. I know that I don't... I know that I don't have anything to show for in my life.
我懂。我的人生里……没有一丝值得夸耀的东西。

I ain't educated. I've got a short fuse and a brutish personality.
我没受过教育，性格也不好，还经常骂人。

Tell me, Clockhead... no, Manager.
告诉我吧，钟表头……不。经理。

This endless, overwhelming flood... Is this what it's like to face my sins?
我要面对的罪孽，是如此绝望而又无尽来袭的吗？

Was my life so wretched that I deserve to suffer this endless swarm of sins?
无论我将其挥开多少次，这无尽的罪孽还是会向我袭来，我的人生难道就错到如此地步了吗？

That can't be true.
不会是那样的。

I wanted to believe that it can't be true.
我想要相信。

That, with the will and the determination to forge on...
如果是拥有想要继续向前迈进的意志和决心的人的话……

... the mist that once seemed impenetrable will one day part, and we will see the light at the end of the tunnel.
就终有一天可以拨云见日。

That every struggle he endured, every lesson he's learned in this journey... couldn't have been for nothing.
迄今为止在旅途中的努力与领悟绝对没有白费。

So please, please don't doubt the path I'm showing you.
所以，也请相信我所为你指明的道路。

But...
但是……

There's... more of them.
他们……又涌过来了。

They number greater than the last.
数量多于先前。

But when I've led you into such absolute darkness... without even a hint of light...
但如果我向你展示的路是如此黑暗，看不到一丝光明时……

<What should I...>
<我该……>

When even I'm starting to feel lost... What should I... do...?
当我似乎也迷失了方向时……该如何是好……
